MetaCyc:PWY-7722

The complete five-transformation sulfo-Entner-Doudoroff route from free sulfoquinovose to pyruvate and sulfolactate in Pseudomonas putida strain SQ1 (DSM 100120). Six exact Rhea activities represent the five native members because the final SLA oxidation has alternative NAD- and NADP-dependent forms. All five SQ1 enzymes were reconstituted in vitro and induced during aerobic SQ growth. Current native reaction structures and reviewed Rhea/UniProt assignments retain S-SLA/S-SL; older native protein prose linking R-SLA is superseded

MetaCyc:PWY-7722

The complete five-transformation sulfo-Entner-Doudoroff route from free sulfoquinovose to pyruvate and sulfolactate in Pseudomonas putida strain SQ1 (DSM 100120). Six exact Rhea activities represent the five native members because the final SLA oxidation has alternative NAD- and NADP-dependent forms. All five SQ1 enzymes were reconstituted in vitro and induced during aerobic SQ growth. Current native reaction structures and reviewed Rhea/UniProt assignments retain S-SLA/S-SL; older native protein prose linking R-SLA is superseded
